## Change

Explain the problem, resulting behavior, rule choices, and public references.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `bin/prophet selftest` and relevant optional dependency checks.
- [ ] Added public reference or fictional fixture coverage where behavior changes.
- [ ] Updated docs and regenerated schemas when command contracts change.
- [ ] Preserved engine rules, warnings, raw times, and approximate branches.
- [ ] Privacy checked: no real birth data, private locations, caches, draw logs, credentials, or personalized reports.
- [ ] Checked release file list; no vendor checkouts, generated corpora, node_modules, or ephemeris files.
- [ ] Preserved third-party licence and attribution notices.
